data.name: StructureDamageViewer
data.shortDescription: Colors indicate health of structures for easy repair
data.description:
# Dynamic Damage Viewer Mod

Enhance your gaming experience with the Dynamic Damage Viewer Mod! This mod visually indicates the health of structures and logs in your game using color codes, making it easier to identify and repair damaged structures.

- **80-99% Health:** Green Color
- **40-85% Health:** Orange Color
- **Under 40% Health:** Red Color

As you repair the structures, the color will update in real-time to reflect the current health status. Never miss a damaged structure again with this intuitive visual aid!

#### How To Use By Default:
-- In Mods Settings: There is an option for showing damaged colors only when RepairTool is in hand, this is default behavior.  But structure damage can be showed all the time if this is turned off 

####Commands:
1. StructureDamageViewer [on/off]

Made by SmokyAce

versions.changelog: Added Option For Only Showing Damage When Repair Tool Is In Hand
